title: LA City General Fund postings, May 2026 vs May 2025

attempts.text: The May 2026 General Fund postings, compared with the May 2025 figures, show a significant decrease of 1.7% from $886.1m to $871.1m. This decline is attributed to a decrease in Fire postings by $30.1m, which is a notable decrease from the $67.6m posted in May 2025. Additionally, Non-Departmental - Liability Claims postings decreased by $17.8m, marking a significant decrease from $10.1m in May 2025. The decrease in Non-Departmental - Human Resources Benefits is also substantial, with postings decreasing by $8.4m, reflecting a decrease from $83.5m in May 2025. The decrease in Police postings is also notable, with postings decreasing by $7.9m, which is a significant decrease from $149.6m in May 2025.

final_text: General Fund postings were $871.1m in May 2026, down 1.7% from $886.1m in May 2025. Year-to-date postings were $8.95bn, up 1.6%. The largest movements were: Fire decreased by $30.1m; Non-Departmental - Liability Claims decreased by $17.8m; Non-Departmental - Human Resources Benefits increased by $8.4m.
